# The image with stricter verdict lines

Milestone 4, 2026-10-25. [All run sets](README.md), [previous: One document at a time](2026-10-25-1922-one-document-at-a-time.md), [next: Thinking on and off](2026-10-25-2211-thinking-on-and-off.md).
